title: Configuration-Dependent Lower Bounds for Approximation by Shallow ReLU$^k$ Networks on the Sphere
abstract: arXiv:2510.04060v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We establish two related but logically distinct results for shallow ReLU$^k$ neural networks on the unit sphere $\SS^d$. First, for an arbitrary set of inner neural-network parameters, the best $\mathcal{L}^2(\SS^d)$ approximation of a fixed target function with smoothness $r>\tfrac{d+2k+1}{2}$ admits an asymptotic lower bound given by a constant multiple of $n^{-1/2}\underline{h}^{k+1/2}$, where $\underline{h}$ denotes the antipodal separation distance of the normalized inner-parameter set. This lower bound depends explicitly on the parameter configuration through $\underline{h}$ and applies without additional assumptions on the parameters. translated_title: 球面上浅层 ReLU$^k$ 网络逼近的构型依赖下界
translated_abstract: 我们针对单位球面 $\SS^d$ 上的浅层 ReLU$^k$ 神经网络建立了两个相关但逻辑上相互独立的结果。首先，对于任意一组内部网络参数，对光滑度为 $r>\tfrac{d+2k+1}{2}$ 的固定目标函数，其最优 $\mathcal{L}^2(\SS^d)$ 逼近存在一个渐近下界，该下界为常数倍的 $n^{-1/2}\underline{h}^{k+1/2}$，其中 $\underline{h}$ 表示归一化内部参数集的对径分离距离。该下界通过 $\underline{h}$ 显式依赖于参数构型，且无需对参数附加任何额外假设即可成立。其次，对于对径拟均匀参数，有 $\underline{h}\simeq n^{-1/d}$，该下界确立了此类参数族的精确饱和阶 $n^{-\frac{d+2k+1}{2d}}$：一个正则性大于 $\frac{d+2k+1}{2}$ 且满足所需条件的目标函数……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了球面上浅层 ReLU$^k$ 网络的逼近误差下界通过参数集的对径分离距离显式依赖于参数构型，并由此推出对径拟均匀参数族具有精确的饱和阶 $n^{-\frac{d+2k+1}{2d}}$。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes configuration-dependent lower bounds for shallow ReLU$^k$ network approximation on the sphere, explicitly governed by the antipodal separation distance of the parameters, and derives the exact saturation order $n^{-\frac{d+2k+1}{2d}}$ for antipodally quasi-uniform parameter families.
